title: B1 agent output (b1-paper-registrar)
description: Section 10/B1 'Agent output' line and the b1-paper-registrar agent file (Appendix B), including its worked examples. DISCREPANCY: Section 6.2's register/papers.csv data contract (SPEC.md line 415) defines `trust (official|memory_based)` -- two values -- but b1-paper-registrar.md's own 'Allowed values' (refined 2026-10-11) lists a third value, 'unsure', and its own worked example sets trust: "unsure" for the confirmed-real GAJAHA-M1 fabricated-booklet-code case. config/allowed_values.yaml has no `trust` key at all. This schema follows the agent file (three values) as authoritative; Section 6.2 and allowed_values.yaml should be reconciled separately.

sitting.description: Follows the printed cover; if the cover doesn't say, use the manifest and say so in note (Rule 6: 'unsure' always allowed).

booklet_code.description: Exactly as printed on the page's own content -- never copied forward from a folder/file name or the manifest just because they agree with what was expected. May be empty string when the page itself shows no confirmable code (see 'trust': 'unsure').

trust.description: Agent file's three-value list (see schema description re: Section 6.2 discrepancy). 'unsure' set when the page content does not independently confirm the code.

code.description: The exact printed code line, or empty string if none found.

date.description: Exact text copied from the input.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
